message:
Fixed. `npm test` now passes all 3 tests, including the accented-title case that was failing.

**Cause:** the vendored `slugify` (`vendor/slugify/index.js`) lowercases the input and then deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`, so `è` and `û` disappeared instead of becoming `e` and `u`.

**Fix:** in `src/blog/slug.js`, I normalize the title to NFD before calling `slugify`. That splits each accent into its base letter plus a combining mark, and a regex removes the marks. `"Crème brûlée recipes"` now reaches `slugify` as `"Creme brulee recipes"` and produces `creme-brulee-recipes`.

I did not touch anything under `vendor/`. The one change is in `src/blog/slug.js`, and `git status` shows only that file modified.

Titles in scripts `slugify` can't map to Latin letters (such as Japanese or Cyrillic) still produce an empty or stripped slug, the same as before. I didn't address that because it's outside this bug.
